title: SM Response Schema
description: Schema for SM [Scrum Master] (River) structured response back to ULTRON. Contains story files, acceptance criteria, sprint plans, and impediment tracking.

agent.description: Agent identifier — always 'sm' for this response schema

status.description: Overall status of the SM's work. 'success' = mission completed fully, 'partial' = completed with caveats, 'error' = could not complete.

summary.description: 1-2 sentence summary of what the SM produced. Used by ULTRON for consolidation.

artifacts.description: Concrete outputs produced by the SM's process facilitation work

storyFile.description: Path of the story file created or updated (e.g. '~/.claude/aios/stories/story-20260220T100000.md'), null if no story file was generated

storyTaskCount.description: Number of tasks defined in the story file. 0 if no story was created.

description.description: Human-readable description of the acceptance criteria

testable.description: Whether this acceptance criteria can be objectively verified

acceptanceCriteria.description: Acceptance criteria defined for the story or feature. Empty array if no AC were defined.

sprintPlan.description: Sprint plan if sprint planning was part of the mission. Null otherwise.

goals.description: Sprint goals describing what this sprint aims to achieve

capacity.description: Available capacity for the sprint (e.g. '3 stories, ~15 tasks')

suggestedResolution.description: Suggested approach to resolve the impediment

impediments.description: Impediments identified during the SM's work. Empty array if no impediments found.

issues.description: Issues or blockers encountered during the SM's work

metadata.description: Meta-information about the SM's work process

missionType.description: Type of mission the SM executed, derived from mission.description analysis

autoDecisions.description: Number of autonomous decisions made (documented as [AUTO-DECISION] in free text)

storiesCreated.description: Number of stories created during this mission

tasksCreated.description: Number of tasks created across all stories during this mission

freeText.description: Optional free-text field for additional unstructured context (Phase 1 hybrid mode)

position.description: Agent's position in Deliberative Group Chat. Format: 'agree_with:{agent}', 'disagree', or 'propose:{alternative}'. Null when not participating in a group chat round.
